proceeding: Application of Rocky Mountain Power for Approval of a Large-Load Service Contract between PacifiCorp and a Large-Load Customer
how_obtained: Found the docket page on psc.utah.gov (a WordPress site: /<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/docket-no-<docket>/), read its raw HTML and pulled the pscdocs.utah.gov links out of it. Utah serves every document at a flat, guessable path: https://pscdocs.utah.gov/<utility>/<yy>docs/<docketdigits>/<docid><AbbreviatedTitle><m-d-yyyy>.pdf, with no login and no session. Downloaded with curl and extracted text with PyMuPDF sorted-block extraction (page.get_text('text', sort=True)), pages joined with a form feed (\x0c). No cleaning, reflow, de-hyphenation or whitespace normalisation.
document_title: Redacted Direct Testimony of Craig M. Eller for Rocky Mountain Power
version_role: paired with the same witness's rebuttal of 2026-03-10
confidentiality: Public redacted version. The unredacted counterpart was deliberately NOT sought.
notes: Section VI is headed RESERVATION CHARGE and explains a three-part rate: a Reservation Charge for capital costs, an Energy Charge, and surcharges. Useful for a second reason: the redactions leave visible gaps mid-sentence, e.g. 'Customer is required to pay a [gap] Reservation Charge based on the [gap]'. A verifier that matches a quote here will find the sentence and not the number, which is exactly the case where a product must escalate rather than guess.
